job.title: [Post] Hiring: Platform Reliability Engineer 100% Remote | West Hartford, CT ... SAP Commerce Clo…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Reliability, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and microservices. Proven track record designing and operating CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes deployments on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2). Strong in production support, performance tuning, and PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, bridging business and technical teams to ensure reliable, scalable platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Platform Reliability Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Gayatri Jena because your focus on building reliable, cloud-native platforms aligns with my passion for delivering stable e-commerce services at scale. With over five years designing, operating, and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and production reliability.

bullets.label: Reliability Engineering
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I led production support and resolved integration bottlenecks, ensuring 99.9% uptime for the SAP Commerce Cloud platform.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Automation
bullets.text: Implemented and executed CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) at both Rockwell and Shell, automating builds, tests and deployments.

bullets.label: Container Orchestration
bullets.text: Deployed and managed Docker-based microservices on Kubernetes clusters, optimizing resource usage and scaling for high-traffic storefronts.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Designed OCC REST APIs and data pipelines integrating PIM, ERP and MDM systems, delivering seamless data flow and robust service contracts.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your platform reliability goals.

tailoring.why_company: Gayatri Jena’s commitment to delivering high-performance, cloud-native platforms resonates with my experience in ensuring reliability for large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud deployments. The fully remote model and focus on modern infrastructure such as Docker and Kubernetes provide the ideal environment for me to apply my proven CI/CD and production-support expertise while contributing to innovative e-commerce solutions for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Gayatri Jena build ultra-reliable, cloud-native platforms, leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud, CI/CD and container expertise to drive uptime and performance.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years of experience in CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes. I’m eager to discuss the Platform Reliability Engineer role at Gayatri Jena. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Platform Reliability Engineer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Platform Reliability Engineer position. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have deep experience in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and production reliability. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
